                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_subject

                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m328_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 328 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_resolved value = 1 }

                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m328_object_route = 3 }

            }

                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m328_object_route = 2 }

                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_cl_mentor_subject
                var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner = {
                    random_vassal = {
                        limit = {
                            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
                            NOT = { this = scope:zg361_cl_mentor_subject }
                        }
                        save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_cl_external_mentor
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:zg361_cl_external_mentor }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor value = scope:zg361_cl_external_mentor }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_distinct value = 1 }
                }
                else = {
                    # A missing distinct mentor is an observable negative object,
                    # never a fabricated successful cross-team match.
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_missing value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_distinct value = 0 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentee value = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_days value = 190 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.829 days = 190 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_days value = 190 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.829 days = 190 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_days value = 190 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.829 days = 190 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m329_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 329 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 329 } }
    }
}

# 329 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m329_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 3
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_active_mentor_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_goal_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_committed_hours value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_capacity_payment value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_deadline_before value = 190 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_deadline_after value = 190 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_rematch_limit value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_rematch_used value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_application_evidence value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_credit value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_rematch_used value = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_mentor_distinct = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_active_mentor_count value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_application_evidence value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_credit value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_match_failed value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m329_mentor_credit }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 329 learning.match_cross_team_mentor"
    }
}

# 329 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m329_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 329 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_match_window_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 1 var:zg361_cl_m329_mentor_distinct = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_application_evidence value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_credit value = 1 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 329 mentor_match obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m329_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m329_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}
